_meta.title: Originated lines — 2026-11-13 through 2026-11-16 slate

empirical_dispersion.caveat: n=14 (13 for totals). Small sample; the dispersion estimate is directional, not final.

known_gaps: No home-court advantage applied — no official NBA source publishes a league HCA figure, and the 14-game sample shows a mean home margin of -0.14 points, which is far too noisy to estimate HCA from.
No rest / back-to-back adjustment — schedule-density source not captured for all teams.
No injury adjustment baked into these lines — injuries are applied separately in injury_impact.py and shown alongside, not silently merged.
No sportsbook line is used or shown, so 'edge' cannot be computed yet.

games.competition: Emirates NBA Cup — East Group B
games.formula: POSS = pace_home + pace_away - league_pace; PTS = (OffRtg_team * DefRtg_opp / league_OffRtg) * POSS / 100; TOTAL = PTS_home + PTS_away; SPREAD = PTS_home - PTS_away
games.ml_formula: normal CDF of projected margin / margin_sd, converted to American odds
